items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: I made my audition for Noble Sissle, and I got accepted... So, I worked with Sissle. We went backwards and forwards to Monte Carlo, and Paris...

ctx.x: And that was Noble Sissle's secret. Noble Sissle's secret was that he had -- he played for the high society, as you say. And his secret was, you can play as you want to, but not noisy. You can give them what you want, but not boisterously, you see. And that's -- well I kept that not only as a motto, I kept that idea which was musical, very musical. You can swing and bounce as much as you want to. You don't have to blow the house down, you know, in order to swing, you don't have to.
Singer, yes. He was an entertainer, singer, and actor. You've heard of Sissle and Blake?
